# SuitePacific

> Boutique NetSuite post-go-live support and consulting. SuiteScript development, workflow automation, integration maintenance, and ongoing account management for companies already live on NetSuite.

## Services

- [NetSuite Post-Go-Live Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-post-go-live-support): What ongoing support covers after the implementation ends
- [NetSuite Managed Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-managed-support): Fixed monthly retainer covering development, administration, break-fix, and upgrade preparation
- [NetSuite Health Check](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-health-check): Structured account review to identify performance, customization, and integration issues
- [NetSuite Partner Replacement](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-partner-replacement): Transition from an implementation partner to a retained specialist
- [NetSuite ACS Alternative](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-acs-alternative): Third-party support that covers customizations and integrations excluded by ACS
- [NetSuite Integrations](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-integrations): Shopify, Salesforce, Celigo, Boomi, and custom middleware integration maintenance
- [SuiteCompare](https://suitepacific.com/suitecompare): Side-by-side comparison of NetSuite record versions and release changes

## Key resources

- [How to evaluate a NetSuite support partner](https://suitepacific.com/blog/how-to-evaluate-netsuite-support-partner): Criteria and questions for selecting a post-go-live provider
- [How to switch NetSuite partners](https://suitepacific.com/blog/how-to-switch-netsuite-partners): Transition process, knowledge transfer, and what to do when the outgoing partner is uncooperative
- [NetSuite saved search formula examples](https://suitepacific.com/blog/netsuite-saved-search-formula-examples): Oracle SQL patterns for CASE WHEN, NVL, date math, and AR aging buckets
- [NetSuite saved search tips](https://suitepacific.com/blog/netsuite-saved-search-tips): Practical techniques for finance and operations teams
- [RESTlet vs REST Web Services](https://suitepacific.com/blog/netsuite-restlet-vs-rest-web-services): Decision framework and NLAuth to TBA migration guide
- [NetSuite account performance](https://suitepacific.com/blog/netsuite-account-performance): Diagnosing and fixing slow NetSuite accounts
- [Implementation partner vs managed support](https://suitepacific.com/blog/netsuite-implementation-partner-vs-managed-support): What post-implementation support covers and how it differs from an implementation engagement

## About

SuitePacific is a boutique consulting firm focused exclusively on post-go-live NetSuite accounts. Credentials: SuiteCloud Developer II, Administrator Professional. Engagements are month-to-month; no annual lock-in. Direct access to the consultant managing the account on every request.
